title: Anyone else? My mall is closing down.
content: Last night I visited my mall. I usually enter at an area that reminds me of old time Circus Circus in Las Vegas, all reds and golds and lights and designs in velvet. From there I move into a large crisp open area with several hallways to choose from. They seem to go to the mall, an airport, a hotel, an upscale department store (with a crappy grocery attached), a college bookstore and an exit to a condensed version of neighborhoods I grew up in or worked in. The neighborhood leads to a parking garage that is dark, crumbling and defies the laws of physics, and on the far end, leads to a manufacturing factory with an insanely large coed locker room. (The bathrooms are somewhere else). Anyways, most of my mall was shut down last night. Empty or missing store fronts. My favorite restaurant is gone. Hardly any people. The lights were on in Circus Circus area showing all the flaws in the illusion of glam and sophistication. Most of the place was stripped down to empty shelves and missing fixtures. My mall is deteriorating before my eyes! Where is it going? What does this mean? How do I get it back?
